ansem thesis 1/2:

my biggest bag and probably the strongest conviction ive ever had in a coin, even after getting absolutely destroyed on it

first of all, the mindshare to mcap ratio here is fucking ridiculous

think about how much attention ansem and his coin get on CT. half the tl hates him, the other half defends him, and somehow everyone has an opinion. even the ppl who claim he's irrelevant spend their days talking about him

and this ties into something ive been thinking about for a while. entertainment finance

i genuinely believe social trading apps like pumpfun could eventually become some of the biggest consumer apps in the world. not just "crypto" apps. actual mainstream entertainment, potentially competing for the #1 spot on the app store

and who do you think benefits the most from that?

ansem is already one of the biggest characters in crypto, with an insane distribution network and a proven ability to capture attention. now imagine pumpfun reaching millions of mainstream users and ansem consistently sitting at the top of the pnl leaderboards

his trades, his wins, his losses, his entire persona becoming entertainment for an audience 10 or 100x bigger than today's CT

and $ANSEM being the asset people associate with that persona

thats a much bigger opportunity than just another memecoin having a good few days/weeks on twitter imo

the idea that Ansem deliberately rugged everyone over a fraction of what he’s already built is honestly ridiculous.

questioning the Pump.fun affiliation or Bullpen’s security is completely fair, but pretending this was some calculated exit scam despite everything that’s come out is a different story.

49% of the supply remains secured in the BitGo multisig and untouched. the compromised wallets and the security vulnerability have been publicly addressed.

there’s a difference between holding someone accountable and blindly pushing a narrative because it’s easier to believe.

i’m watching how this plays out. the market might be overlooking the bigger picture here. 

https://x.com/derangedstates/status/2125455193445654928?a=WfbLymD9JopoQh19nkE&s=46

Ansem just provided a much bigger update on what actually happened.

the 49% of the supply held in the BitGo multisig remains completely safe and untouched. only the Solana wallets connected to Bullpen were compromised.

he also confirmed the exploit came from a security vulnerability involving legacy accounts that allowed attackers to bypass production 2FA, affecting all 19 compromised accounts.

he’s been coordinating with legal, developers and law enforcement to recover the funds.

most importantly, he’s being transparent about the situation and explicitly telling users to withdraw from Bullpen until its security can be verified.

people were quick to assume the worst but there’s a lot more context here than initially understood.

the 49% supply allocation remains untouched. that’s a pretty important detail. 

https://x.com/blknoiz06/status/2125437574965539054?a=WYk_xY_2es6sLHynsUw&s=46

The latest Bullpen update adds another interesting layer to this situation.

the security incident was limited to just 19 accounts, all beta testers from april to june 2024, with no other users affected and no further movement of funds reported.

this makes the situation a lot more interesting than the initial speculation suggested.

if Ansem manages to recover and comes back swinging, the narrative could turn around very quickly.

people might be underestimating this one. 

https://x.com/bullpenfi/status/2125426080328700198?a=l8VM0PRBEzZ10voeCjM&s=46

Ansem coming back with a $5M injection and people are still fading this?

sometimes you have to be willing to take a chance before the opportunity becomes obvious.

the upside speaks for itself.

$ANSEM situation is getting more interesting by the hour.

the more details that come out the harder it becomes to ignore the possibility that this was an actual compromise rather than what people on CT are trying to make it out to be.

everyone was quick to jump to conclusions but there’s clearly more to this story than a wallet getting drained.

i think people are seriously underestimating how quickly sentiment could shift once the full picture comes out.

the market loves a comeback narrative. 👀

https://x.com/bullpenfi/status/2125267130870272331
Don’t fade the bull
Whatever you think Ansem is the man and his token hit rock bottom lately. IMO this is a great opportunity to get in.
